summary: No findings. Hidden information: handResultView builds its winner set only from result.awards and looks up showdown entries only for those seats, so losers' hole cards are never read; on endedBy 'fold' handName and holeCards are null; it never touches the deck or the next hand. tableView still reads through playerView, and the only change there is a button fallback plus a throwing stack lookup. Replay code: no src/ui file renders replayCode. Fresh code per hand: the next-hand timer calls newCode() when it fires, and production (App -> TableScreen -> Table) passes no newCode, so the default newReplayCode (crypto.getRandomValues) is used. nextHand also clears replayCode to null, so the previous code can't carry over. Timers: one setTimeout per effect run, cleared in cleanup when table/holdNextHand change or the component unmounts (Leave table). The updater only deals if nextStep(t) === 'done', and after dealing the state moves on to bot or user, so a stale or doubled callback can't deal twice. The code is drawn outside the updater. Top-up: only seats with stack < minimumStack get reset to buyIn (and buyIn = 20*bigBet is above the minimum). It applies the same way to every seat and has no input except the hand's final stacks, so the user can't trigger it any other way. Dependencies and bundle: package.json and the lockfile are unchanged. No src file imports tests/ or table-scenarios, and the existing dist bundle has no fixedDeck/KINGS_SHOWDOWN/table-scenarios strings.
